intro: We started from a belief, not a product: if you empower people to do good, they will do good. Everything on this page is an attempt to put that into something you can open, flash, or run.

The studio works a particular way. An agreement is written before the code. Agents do real work, and a person checks it before it counts. Models run on machines we keep in the building, so the data stays with the people it belongs to. When something goes wrong we write the rule down and keep going.

Below is the honest shape of the house as of {{today}}. Where a public address answered that day, we say so. Where something is still being built, we say that too. The longer working list, with a rating on every name, is [INVENTORY.md](/INVENTORY.md).

door.title: Work with us
text: If you need something built, this is the kind of thing we are good at: a small product end to end, an agent that does real work inside limits you can read, software that runs on hardware you keep, and the odd embedded device. We say what is live, what is built, and what is still a drawing, before you pay for any of it.
Write to Loke. A person reads it, usually the same day.
